question: Who among the following was appointed as the new Chief of Defence Staff in September 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __Anil Chauhan.__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Anil Chauhan:

 
 
• Born on May 18, 1961, General Anil Chauhan holds four stars in the Indian Army.
 
• Currently serving as the Indian Armed Forces' second Chief of Defence Staff (CDS) since September 30, 2022.
 
• The Narendra Modi-led government recalled Chauhan from retirement on September 28, 2022, and named him as the Chief of Defence Staff (CDS). This came about as a result of a June 2022 announcement that allowed military retirees under the age of 62 to be eligible for the position.
 
• **He** **became the** first three-star retiree to be appointed to the position, **which is** usually held by a four-star officer,** and took over as commander two days later.**
 
• General Bipin Rawat was the first person to hold the position, and he succeeded him.
 
• Awards:
 
 
• Param Vishisht Seva Medal (PVSM)
 
• Uttam Yudh Seva Medal (UYSM)
 
• Ati Vishisht Seva Medal (AVSM)
 
• Sena Medal (SM)
 
• Vishisht Seva Medal (VSM)
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Ajai Singh:

 
 
• He is a Retired Indian Army Lieutenant General.
 
• **He headed** Andaman and Nicobar Command (CINCAN) as its 16th Commander-in-Chief. **On June 1, 2021,** **he** succeeded Lieutenant-General Manoj Pande, PVSM, AVSM, VSM, in leadership.
 
• He was awarded: 
 
 
• Vishisht Seva Medal (VSM)
 
• Ati Vishisht Seva Medal (AVSM)
 
• Param Vishisht Seva Medal (PVSM)
 
 
 
 
 
• Bipin Rawat:
 
 
• Four-star general of the Indian Army **General Bipin Rawat was an Indian military officer who served** from 16 March 1958 to 8 December 2021. **Before his death in a helicopter crash in December 2021, he was the** first Chief of Defence Staff (CDS) of the Indian Armed Forces,** having taken** office in January 2020. **He held the positions of** 26th Chief of the Army Staff (COAS) and 57th Chairman of the Chiefs of Staff Committee (Chairman COSC) **of the Indian Armed Forces before becoming the CDS.**
 
• Awards:
 
 
• Param Vishisht Seva Medal (PVSM)
 
• Uttam Yudh Seva Medal (UYSM)
 
• Ati Vishisht Seva Medal (AVSM)
 
• Sena Medal (SM)
 
• Vishisht Seva Medal (VSM)
 
 
 
 
 
• Manoj Pande:
 
 
• **Born on May 6, 1962, General Manoj Pande is a serving** four-star officer in the Indian Army.
 
• **He is** currently the 29th Chief of Staff.
 
• **He had held the positions of** Vice Chief of Staff, Eastern Command's General Officer-Commanding-in-Chief, and Andman and Nicobar Command's Commander-in-Chief (CINCAN)** in the past.**
 
• He is the first officer to hold the position of Army Chief from both the Corps of Engineers and non-infantry/armoured corps.
 
• He was awarded: 
 
 
• Vishisht Seva Medal (VSM)
 
• Ati Vishisht Seva Medal (AVSM)
 
• Param Vishisht Seva Medal (PVSM)
